description: This file defines the ChartHelper class which provides static methods for creating and configuring 3D surface plots and controls related to XYData visualization, including UI components and surface model setup.

classes.name: ChartHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for creating 3D surface plots and UI controls for XYData visualization.

methods.name: create3DControl
methods.description: Creates a JPanel containing a 3D surface plot with controls for RPM and MAF voltage, including a save image button.

methods.name: createDefaultSurfaceModel
methods.description: Overloaded methods to create a DefaultSurfaceModel for XYData, optionally with a second dataset and specified ranges.

methods.name: setYRange
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis range of a surface model.
